baselinePolicy.label: Original calm idle
baselinePolicy.description: The approved pre-existing idle is the resting state between activities.

npcs.label: Player Upgrades
npcs.rhythm: Precise hand business around goggles, cylinder, tools, and plans; both boots remain planted.

activities.label: Blueprint calibration
activities.description: Unroll and inspect the plan with a precise hand movement.

activities.label: Spark catch
activities.description: A harmless gadget spark surprises him before a controlled recovery.

activities.label: Present the plan
activities.description: Acknowledge the player and proudly present the plan.

activities.label: Adjust goggles
activities.description: Check the lens while the cylinder stays secure.

activities.label: Tune the cylinder
activities.description: Use a small belt tool for a careful adjustment.

activities.label: Mark the notes
activities.description: Review and mark the existing blueprint notes.

activities.label: Brace the device
activities.description: Re-seat the cylinder and hold it with quiet pride.

npcs.label: Gear Merchant
npcs.rhythm: Heavy grounded gear checks led by strap, lamp, pouch, pickaxe, and beard.

activities.label: Inspect the edge
activities.description: Bring forward and inspect the existing pickaxe edge.

activities.label: Tool catch
activities.description: Catch a slipping tool and recover with sturdy satisfaction.

activities.label: Present the gear
activities.description: Offer the pickaxe with an open merchant gesture.

activities.label: Tighten the strap
activities.description: Settle the backpack weight without shifting his boots.

activities.label: Polish the lamp
activities.description: Clean the helmet lamp with a practiced hand.

activities.label: Check the pouch
activities.description: Inspect a familiar bottle and tool pouch.

activities.label: Beard and pickaxe
activities.description: Lean on the planted pickaxe and scratch his beard.

npcs.label: Bobo Merchant
npcs.rhythm: Friendly nose, ears, scarf, medallion, tail, and potion overlap while paws stay home.

activities.label: Potion rummage
activities.description: Rummage in the backpack and pull forward an existing bottle.

activities.label: Dog shake
activities.description: A playful in-place shake with delayed ears, tail, bottle, and medallion.

activities.label: Potion wave
activities.description: Notice the player, wave warmly, and offer the bottle.

activities.label: Potion sniff
activities.description: Sniff the familiar potion and consider the result.

activities.label: Straighten scarf
activities.description: Neaten the scarf and medallion with both paws planted.

activities.label: Curious listen
activities.description: Tilt the head as ears and tail answer a distant sound.

activities.label: Proud potion
activities.description: Present the potion with an inviting open paw.

npcs.label: Money Monster
npcs.rhythm: Coin, pouch, necklace, and eye acting create variety without a single roaming step.

activities.label: Count and roll
activities.description: Count loose coins while the eye tracks them.

activities.label: Test and protect
activities.description: Bite-test the coin, hug the pouch, and squint suspiciously.

activities.label: Hide and tempt
activities.description: Guard the pouch while tempting the player with one coin.

activities.label: Stack the coins
activities.description: Balance a neat stack on one broad hand.

activities.label: Polish a coin
activities.description: Buff one favorite coin against the robe.

activities.label: Listen to the pouch
activities.description: Rattle the pouch gently and judge its sound.

activities.label: Fan the fortune
activities.description: Display a proud fan of coins while guarding the pouch.

npcs.label: Gem Power Merchant
npcs.rhythm: Staff and crystal business stays weighty, deliberate, and exactly bottom-anchored.

activities.label: Crystal orbit
activities.description: Levitate two or three crystals in a readable arc.

activities.label: Controlled overload
activities.description: Brace through a short crystal flare and dust release.

activities.label: Open the display
activities.description: Present the staff and crystal satchel to the player.

activities.label: Examine a gem
activities.description: Bring one gem close to the eye for inspection.

activities.label: Tune the staff
activities.description: Touch a gem to the planted staff and listen for resonance.

activities.label: Arrange the cluster
activities.description: Re-seat the crystal cluster in the satchel.

activities.label: Resonance pulse
activities.description: Send a restrained pulse around the planted staff.

npcs.label: Magma Money Monster
npcs.rhythm: Scale, chest, coin, chain, and furnace heat move while the massive feet stay locked.

activities.label: Weigh a coin
activities.description: Add one coin and lean in to judge the scale.

activities.label: Ember sneeze
activities.description: A heat surge jolts the pans before a firm recovery.

activities.label: Make the deal
activities.description: Level the scales and offer a confident deal gesture.

activities.label: Inspect the coin
activities.description: Study one warm coin close to the furnace eye.

activities.label: Rebalance scales
activities.description: Correct the two scale pans with careful weight.

activities.label: Lock the chest
activities.description: Check and secure the heavy chest clasp.

activities.label: Vent the furnace
activities.description: Release a controlled heat flare while holding every prop firm.
